verdict.rationale: Goodwin has its own dedicated Data, Privacy & Cybersecurity practice page. It describes a long-standing, top-ranked practice whose specialists include former federal prosecutors, which glancingly suggests incident and enforcement capability. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of security-incident and breach-response services, regulator-facing work such as notifications and investigations, a dedicated incident-response page, and independent corroboration.

support.subject: As a legal-ops lead, the firm handles security-incident and breach response, including regulator-facing work, documented on its own pages

citations.quote: Our top-ranked Data, Privacy & Cybersecurity practice is one of the longest-standing of any Am Law 50 firm. Across the United States and Europe, our specialists include former federal prosecutors.
